messages.subject: Aquilo framework - we have a deal
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin,

Good to speak. Calderwater is content to hold termination for convenience at the third anniversary on 6 months' notice, on the basis we've agreed the 8% shortfall and the rest of v3. I think that closes the last point. Our lawyers can move to an execution version.

Looking forward to a long partnership.

Daniel Mercer
Head of Capital Procurement, Calderwater Utilities Limited
